documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: For Q1 FY27, Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations to ₹ 472.2 crores and a 44.5% YoY increase in EBITDA to ₹ 92.3 crores. The company is undertaking a capex of ~₹ 200 crore to expand its ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA, targeted for commissioning by 30th September 2026. This expansion is fully funded through internal accruals, supported by a debt-free balance sheet. Management expects optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported its FY26 investor presentation detailing financial and operational performance.

guidance.claim: The company expects optimal utilisation of its expanded ABS capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

guidance.claim: The company expects the commissioning of its enhanced capacity to be completed by the end of September 2026.
guidance.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global ABS resin demand owing to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for ABS will be driven by growth in end-user industries including automotive and consumer durables.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating plastic consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight materials for interior trims and battery housings.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained strong across key home appliance categories including refrigerators and air conditioners.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained strong across key categories such as refrigerators, air conditioners, washing machines, microwave ovens and small kitchen appliances.

demand_outlook.claim: There is significant scope for growth due to a supply-demand mismatch where Indian ABS consumption exceeds total domestic producer output.
demand_outlook.quote: There is immense scope for growth, considering the existing supply and demand mismatch, and knowing the fact that the consumption of ABS in India is voluminously larger as compared to the combined output of the domestic manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The IMD forecast of a normal monsoon in 2026 is expected to support rural demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The IMD's June forecast indicates a normal-to-above-normal monsoon for 2026, reducing El Niño risk — a meaningful positive for rural demand and food inflation.

capex_expansion.claim: Orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipment for the expansion of ABS capacity from 75,000 TPA to 100,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Engineering, procurement, and construction work is ongoing to complete the capacity expansion by late September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at ₹ 92.3 crores with a margin of 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores with margins at 20.0%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an operating margin of 19.42% and a net profit margin of 14.14% in FY 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA in FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved production volume of 71601 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for FY 2025-26 stood at 71,501 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume stood at 71501 TPA (Previous year - 74381 TPA).

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with zero financial risk.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a healthy average dividend payout ratio of over 50%.
capital_allocation.quote: Healthy dividend payout (~50%+)* reflects disciplined capital allocation and shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains its zero-debt status.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects to sustain its operations using internal accruals without changing its financing pattern.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared three interim dividends of Re. 1 each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces foreign exchange fluctuation risks due to import dependency on key raw materials like Styrene and Acrylonitrile.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

risks_headwinds.claim: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and potential damage to hydrocarbon facilities present severe energy crisis risks globally.
risks_headwinds.quote: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and serious damage to critical production facilities in a region central to global hydrocarbon supply could cause an energy crisis on an unprecedented scale.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the enhanced ABS capacity to 100,000 TPA is targeted for completion by the end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
